Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the time last week. Following up to confirm the demo we penciled for Tue, Feb 24 at 10am PT. I've attached a short proposed agenda and the MVP requirements you shared so we can tailor examples.

Proposed 30-minute agenda:
- 5m intro & success criteria
- 15m live inference demo (few prompts + latency/cost talk)

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for putting this together and for the materials. I wanted to flag that we've had a product roadmap reprioritization this week: leadership is pausing all new ML/LLM initiatives while we reallocate engineering cycles to the checkout performance project and a major retail trade show travel period. That means we need to postpone the inference POC and the demo for now.

Can we push this out 6–8 weeks? I don't have a definitive date yet — the plan is to reassess after our March roadmap sync. Also there's a temporary hiring freeze and procurement is tight, so it may affect timing for a paid pilot. We still want to evaluate Redwood, just not on the current timeline.

Appreciate your flexibility. If you want to keep any materials handy in the meantime, Ben and I will review them offline. Please do not schedule anything during the week of Mar 2–6; the team will be traveling.

Best,
Aisha Phillips
Senior PM, Product Strategy — Northfield Retail
aisha.phillips@northfieldretail.com
